# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 6 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 33 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_006_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 6

**1** His disciples [маθнтнс] questioned him [шоул eroч] and said: "Do you want us to fast [нностеуе]? How shall we pray [шлнл]? Shall we give alms [рпроснпора]? What diet [оуономоу] shall we observe?"

**2** Jesus said: "Do not lie [чол ноуе]. And do not do what you hate [мосте],

**3** for all things are plain [оуонх евол] before heaven [тпе].

**4** For there is nothing hidden [хнп] that will not be made manifest [оуонх евол],

**5** and nothing covered [хнп] that will remain without being disclosed [оуонх евол]."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *шоул*: to ask, question; disciples pose a practical religious question
- *нностеуе*: to fast; Greek loan-word νηστεύειν
- *шлнл*: to pray; native Coptic verb
- *рпроснпора*: to give alms, make offerings; Greek loan-word
- *оуономоу*: diet, food restrictions, purity observances
- Vv.4-5 repeat the core of Saying 5 — the repetition may indicate an editorial join between two originally separate traditions
- cf. P.Oxy 654 lines 32-40 for Greek parallel with significant variants
